wallpaperDesc.zh: 在整页底层铺一张自己的图片或视频；只在选择本插件配色时可见。
wallpaperDesc.en: Layers your own image or video under the whole page; visible only under one of this theme's own palettes.

wallpaperFileDesc.zh: PNG、JPEG、WebP 图片或 MP4 视频，不超过 100 MB，保存在本机。
wallpaperFileDesc.en: A PNG, JPEG or WebP image or an MP4 video, up to 100 MB, stored on this device.

wallpaperType.zh: 只接受 PNG、JPEG、WebP 图片或 MP4 视频。
wallpaperType.en: Only PNG, JPEG or WebP images and MP4 videos are accepted.

wallpaperSize.en: The file is larger than 100 MB.

wallpaperVisibilityDesc.zh: 0% 完全遮住，100% 原样显示。
wallpaperVisibilityDesc.en: 0% covers it completely, 100% shows it bare.

wallpaperBlurDesc.zh: 0 为关闭；模糊动画壁纸会多占显卡。
wallpaperBlurDesc.en: 0 turns it off; blurring a video wallpaper costs more GPU.

wallpaperMotionDesc.zh: 只对视频壁纸生效；静态显示停在第一帧。
wallpaperMotionDesc.en: Only a video wallpaper reads it; static holds the first frame.

wallpaperLiteDesc.zh: 停住视频并关掉壁纸模糊。
wallpaperLiteDesc.en: Stills the video and turns the wallpaper's blur off.
